name: WebGPU Ray Marching for 4D Volumes
definition: A real-time volume rendering technique using WebGPU (WGSL) to ray march through 3D spatial data with a temporal dimension (4D), supporting interpolation between time steps and clipping via axis-aligned bounding boxes.
summary: WebGPU Ray Marching for 4D Volumes is a real-time rendering technique that visualizes time-varying volumetric fields by ray marching through 3D spatial data with a temporal dimension.
